source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
3. Clearly identify the date and time the incident occurred.
4. List all individuals present at the scene when the incident happened. Include their names, job titles, and contact information if possible.
5. Detail the specific location where the incident took place, such as building, floor, room, or outside area.
6. Provide a chronological description of the incident, including what led up to it, the sequence of events, and the immediate aftermath.
7. Enumerate the injuries sustained by employees or visitors, if any. Specify the nature, severity, and affected body parts of the injuries.
8. Note any property or equipment damage caused by the accident.
9. Include a statement from the employee(s) directly involved in the incident. Collect written or recorded statements detailing their firsthand account of the event.
10. Gather witness statements from other employees or bystanders who observed the incident. Document their observations as accurately as possible.
11. Attach any relevant documentation:
